files.reuse: Stable local Taylor and Newton exponential divided-difference strategy, phase reduction for exponentials, periodic lattice reconstruction and Kuhn simplex connectivity.
files.adaptation: Rewritten as a worker-safe P0 fixed-mass direct-mode kernel; added analytic signed JVPs, original phase-direction association, arbitrary integer modes, bounded chunks, diagnostics, non-power-of-two grids, and resource cleanup. Removed sampled modes, P1 and silent contribution filters. Engine 0.5.0 adds a new compensated endpoint observer in finite-difference.js, with high/low displacement inputs, reduced-phase polynomial exponentials, runtime rounding barriers, split-product residuals and high/low reductions. A stable amplitude delta integrates the exact continuous directional derivative along retained endpoint geometries with a guarded three-point Gauss rule; stages submit and complete separately before storage consumption. It retains the pinned strategy rather than copying upstream f32 precision policy.

files.reuse: Small pipeline/bind-group, one-dimensional dispatch and readback helper patterns.
files.adaptation: Reimplemented without rendering imports or process-global WebGPU constants; each staging buffer is locally owned and destroyed.
Direct-mode partials use a lane-strided fixed order followed by a 64-lane pairwise tree, with one output per mode and explicit f32 precision.

files.reuse: No source copied. The new context module follows the plan's capability-probe and loss-reporting boundary without a DOM dependency.
Stockham radix-2 autosort butterflies, twiddle table, ping-pong scheduling, and normalized inverse transform.
files.adaptation: Generalized to 1D–3D grids and explicit owned buffers; last-axis-fast layout, force FFT integration and error handling are checked independently against mode and PM fixtures. The PM cosmological KDK/CIC-JVP solver is new and follows the Rust reference, rather than upstream heat-flow dynamics.

files.reuse: Periodic P0/P1 simplex clipping and triangle integration structure for exact sheet-to-cell overlap.
files.adaptation: Reworked around periodic cell-local coordinates and floating-point positive mass contributions. Integer atomics build particle links; each cell gathers its own linked particles and performs ordered compensated summation. The upstream 18-bit fixed-point quantization and atomic fixed-point mass accumulation are not used.

files.reuse: Periodic tetrahedron clipping, graph-based clipped-polyhedron traversal, and cell-local P0 overlap integration.
files.adaptation: Adapted as a floating-point clipping/integration helper used by deposit.js. Cell-local coordinates limit cancellation; integer particle links are followed by per-cell floating-point gathering and compensated summation. No fixed-point quantization or atomic mass summation is retained.

files.reuse: Raw nLPT tensor/source recursion, spectral derivative and inverse-Laplacian conventions, and the 2D/3D term construction structure.
files.adaptation: Implemented for 2D and 3D raw terms with all Hessian components and dimension-specific source channels, using the local radix-2 FFT. Rust retains exact growth functions, EdS merging, temporal evaluation, and final state construction. The upstream Hopf-Cole/Legendre correction, shell-crossing search, and transverse correction are not included.
